explanation: Lomov arrives in formal clothes to propose to Natalya. Chubukov is thrilled and sends Natalya in. However, when Lomov mentions Oxen Meadows, Natalya claims it belongs to her family. The conversation devolves into a loud argument involving Chubukov, causing Lomov to storm out due to heart palpitations. When Natalya learns he came to propose, she demands he be brought back. On his return, they try to avoid land topics, but fall into a second argument over their dogs, Guess and Squeezer. Lomov collapses unconscious from stress. Panicking, Chubukov joins their hands together and declares them engaged. Even as they embrace, they resume arguing over their dogs, illustrating the chaotic nature of farcical theater.
